title: A Fourier Criterion for the Toeplitzness of Operators on Fock Spaces
summary: We give a Fourier criterion for the Toeplitzness of bounded operators on Fock spaces, where Toeplitzness means representability as a Toeplitz operator with a bounded measurable symbol. For a Toeplitz operator, the anti-diagonal restriction of its canonical kernel is the Fourier transform of the Gaussian-weighted symbol. Consequently, Fourier inversion of this anti-diagonal restriction recovers the unique bounded symbol whenever such a representation exists. As applications, we characterize the Toeplitzness of weighted composition operators and generalized Volterra-type operators.
